messages:
Anna (Product): quick sync request — need a short decision on sequencing for Dedicated vs Private investment. two big asks from enterprise customers; want to decide what to ship in next sprint and what to defer.
Miguel (Eng): short answer: we can push a minimal Dedicated capacity bump faster. Private (VPC/on-prem) has more infra + security work.
Sasha (Sales): +1 on Dedicated for speed. several deals stalled on predictable throughput rather than isolation. customers still ask for VPC but timeline matters.
Ben (ML): note: Private has extra model verification/quantization hoops (on-prem hardware variance). that adds time beyond infra.
Priya (Platform): Ops/automation gap for Private is larger — will need KMS/hsm integrations and air-gapped packaging. estimate ~6w extra engineering effort for first customer.
Anna (Product): can we try a quick RICE-ish scoring to make this concrete? aim: pick 1 winner for sprint focus and define explicit launch criteria.
Miguel (Eng): ok throw numbers, we can sanity-check.
Anna (Product): ```
Option A - Dedicated (reserved capacity)
Reach: 7 (most immediate enterprise demand)
Impact: 6 (reduces churn, unlocks deals)
Confidence: 6 (we've done similar infra)
Effort: 4 (infra + autoscale + SLA)
RICE = (7*6*6)/4 = 63

Option B - Private (VPC/on-prem)
Reach: 4 (fewer customers initially)
Impact: 8 (higher ACV, compliance wins)
Confidence: 4 (new product engineering)
Effort: 9 (KMS, packaging, on-prem ops)
RICE = (4*8*4)/9 = 14.2
```
Miguel (Eng): rough but helpful. Dedicated wins numerically — agrees with our gut.
Sasha (Sales): good to show to execs. can we define launch criteria for Dedicated so sales can commit?
Anna (Product): proposed launch criteria for Dedicated: 1) sustained 95th% latency < 200ms at target qps, 2) autoscale to X GPUs in under 90s, 3) tenant isolation tests (no cross-tenant KV leakage), 4) cost dashboard + per-tenant billing. thoughts?
Priya (Platform): add: automated failover policy + rollback path documented, and docs for customers to opt into Dedicated with minimal network changes.
Ben (ML): add an ML criteria: model parity check vs hosted baseline on 10 sentinel prompts (no >5% degradation).
Sasha (Sales): can we also include a simple SLA matrix (latency, availability) that sales can share? even draft is fine.
Anna (Product): yes — I'll draft SLA matrix. next steps: 1) Miguel/Priya scope infra work for Dedicated (estimate in story points), 2) Ben to author parity eval, 3) Sasha to surface top 3 customers to pilot, 4) Anna to produce RACI + draft SLA.
Miguel (Eng): will break into 3 tickets: capacity bump, autoscale hooks, per-tenant billing. ETA for rough estimates by EOD tomorrow.
Priya (Platform): I'll list KMS/HSM impact and whether any of that is needed for Dedicated (probably not for basic Dedicated).
Ben (ML): I'll put together the eval harness and baseline runs; need dev tokens + sample prompts from Sasha's customers.
Sasha (Sales): pinging @Sasha (Sales) — will DM prompt sets and pilot contacts.
Anna (Product): thanks — if everyone agrees, we'll prioritize Dedicated for the sprint and keep Private as a parallel investment for Q2 with a formal spec.
Miguel (Eng): agree from eng side.
Priya (Platform): agree.
Ben (ML): agree.
Sasha (Sales): agree. :rocket:
